text: Well, well, well. If it isn't Wil Wheaton, the Green Goblin to my Spider-Man, the Pope Paul the fifth to my Galileo, the Internet Explorer to my Firefox.

text: You're not still carrying a grudge because I beat you at that card tournament, are you?

text: I'm the proud owner of Wil Wheaton stinks dot com, dot net, and dot org. What does that tell you?

text: It tells me that I am living rent-free right here. You ready to bowl?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh, I'm ready. I don't know if Stuart told you what you're up against tonight, but before you stands the co-captain of the East Texas Christian Youth Holy Roller Bowling League championship team. Seven to twelve year-old division. Also, Penny's pretty good.
